title: Module-valued presheaves as modules over the constant ring presheaf
statement: For a ring k and topological space X, send a ModuleCat k-valued presheaf V to a presheaf of modules over the constant ring presheaf k by taking its module at U to be V(U), and its restriction map to be the same linear map V(U)->V(W). On morphisms keep every component. The identity and composition laws are those of V. Modules may live in Type(max u v) when X and k live in Type u.
